author: Hodgson, 1836
summary: 2022년 6월 제주 마라도의 곰솔숲에서 첫해 어린새 한 마리가 가락지 조사용 그물에 잡혀 처음 기록된 길잃은새다. 히말라야에서 인도차이나와 중국 남서부에 걸쳐 번식하고, 겨울에는 동남아시아를 거쳐 수마트라와 자와 서부까지 내려간다. 열대·아열대의 넓은잎나무 숲과 상록수림에 살며 곤충 같은 작은 동물을 잡아먹는다.

art.subject: Crow-billed Drongo (Dicrurus annectans), adult: plumage entirely black with a blue-green gloss on the upperparts and breast; tail black, fairly long and shallowly forked, much less deeply than Black Drongo's, the outer feathers curving outward and slightly upward near the tips. Bill black, very heavy, broad and deep at the base, with long rictal bristles; iris dark reddish-brown; legs black.
art.pose: perched upright on an exposed branch in the forest mid-storey, side view
art.scene: Broadleaf woodland edge on a Korean offshore island in May, during spring migration, dappled light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched upright on an exposed branch: stocky drongo with a very thick black bill, deep at the base, deep red iris, glossy black plumage, fairly long tail, shallowly forked, with the outer feathers curving outward and slightly upward near the tips, short legs

first-year, side view perched upright: like the adult but with white spots from the breast to the undertail coverts, brownish iris, very thick black bill, glossy black upperparts, shallowly forked tail with the outer feathers curving outward
art.build: Medium-sized drongo, about the size of Black Drongo but stockier, with a much heavier, crow-like bill and a proportionally shorter tail. Bill about as long as the head, deep and broad-based, slightly hooked. Tail shallowly forked, much less deeply than Black Drongo's, the outer feathers curving outward and slightly upward near the tips. Legs short, black. Perches upright on exposed branches in the forest mid-storey and sallies out after insects. Immature birds have small white spots on the breast and belly.
avoid: Do not paint a slim bill, a small white spot at the gape, or a very long, deeply forked tail; those mark Black Drongo (Dicrurus macrocercus).
Do not paint a hair crest or strongly upcurled tail tips (Hair-crested Drongo, Dicrurus hottentottus).
Do not paint grey plumage (Ashy Drongo, Dicrurus leucophaeus).
